versions.changelog:
mcp-zentao-pro 1.1.0

- Expanded documentation with new management and team dashboard usage guidance.
- Added detailed usage instructions and parameters for management aggregation (管理聚合), workload radar, stagnant tasks, standup, and weekly report abilities.
- Updated command line usage examples to reflect new features, team member cache, and richer query/filtering options.
- Clarified distinction between personal and management perspectives in examples and instructions.
- Enhanced sections on advanced abilities: morning standup radar, weekly synthesis, team workload summary, and stagnant tasks tracking.
- Improved quick reference and practical call patterns for both AI tooling and CLI invocation.

- Enhanced global dashboard and task assignment flows to support Chinese name mapping and smarter project/iteration discovery.
- Added Smart Link Resolver: now supports direct parsing of pasted ZenTao links in chat for instant status retrieval.
- Updated CLI examples and documentation to reflect support for Chinese real names and expanded project/iteration management.
- Improved security and environment dependency descriptions for safer authorized operations.
- Refined best practice guidance for task creation, effort logging, and state transitions.

Version 1.0.3 of mcp-zentao-pro

- Added detailed SKILL.md with feature descriptions, best AI usage practices, and CLI installation/usage instructions.
- Outlines four core capabilities: Dashboard data access, chat-based task creation, effortless work logging, and streamlined state transitions.
- Provides clear trigger intents and parameter guidelines for each capability to facilitate correct tool invocation.
- Documents installation instructions and extensive CLI command examples for local/developer use.
- Clarifies current feature maturity, known limitations, and encourages community feedback and contributions.
